<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_IncomeTaxExaminationDescription', window );">Income Tax Examination, Description</a></td>
<td class="text">In order for the Fund to avoid certain excise taxes imposed on RICs, the Fund currently intends to distribute, or be deemed to distribute, during each calendar year an amount at least equal to the sum of (1) 98.0% of the Fund&#8217;s ordinary income for the calendar year, (2) 98.2% of the Fund&#8217;s capital gain in excess of capital loss for the one-year period ending on such calendar year and (3) any ordinary income and net capital gain for preceding years that were not distributed during such years and on which we paid no U.S. federal income tax.<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
